T: Eight hours of suds. One long lunch break.
D: A single day in the lives of the workers at a busy Los Angeles car wash.
P: Serve the lunch when the crew takes a break between cars.
S: the food truck that pulls up at lunchtime
Beef mince cooked with onion, garlic, cumin and chilli, in warm corn tortillas with lettuce, cheese and salsa.
Raw peanuts boiled 2 hours in salted water with Cajun spice, soaked an hour, served warm in paper cups.
the burger stand down the road
Thick fries double fried, covered in a beef and bean chilli and melted cheddar, chopped onion on top.
M: lunch break at the car wash
Franks griddled until blistered, in steamed buns, topped with a spoon of beef chilli simmered with cumin, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish.
a soul food lunch on the break
Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside, with a creamy potato salad and crunchy coleslaw.
W: a scorching day on the job
Fresh orange juice sweetened with a little sugar, poured into moulds over frozen berries, sticks pushed in after an hour, frozen solid for 6 hours.
K: Fresh watermelon blended with cold water and lime, strained and poured over ice.

s.note: the food truck that pulls up at lunchtime
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with an onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and chilli. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with the beef, shredded lettuce, 100g grated cheddar and a spoon of salsa.

s.note: the burger stand down the road
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince with a chopped onion and chilli powder, add a drained tin of kidney beans and a splash of water and simmer 20 minutes. Fry 1kg thick chips twice. Spoon the chilli over, top with 150g cheddar and grill to melt.

m.note: lunch break at the car wash
m.how: Simmer 250g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin, chilli powder and 150ml water for 20 minutes until loose. Griddle 8 franks and put in steamed buns. Top with the chilli, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish.

w.note: a scorching day on the job
w.how: Stir 2 tbsp sugar into 500ml fresh orange juice until dissolved. Drop a few frozen berries into each mould and pour the juice over. Push sticks in after an hour and freeze solid for 6 hours.

d.how: Blend 1kg seedless watermelon flesh with 500ml cold water, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth. Strain into a jug, chill and pour over ice with lime wedges.
